function applyState(state) {
  app.dataset.state = state;
  screens.forEach((screen) => { screen.hidden = screen.dataset.screen !== state; });
  const current = stateStep[state];
  steps.forEach((step, index) => {
    step.classList.toggle('is-complete', Number.isInteger(current) && index < current);
    step.classList.toggle('is-active', index === current);
  });
  currentState = state;
  if (state !== 'attract') armIdleTimer();
}

function playScreenEntrance(state) {
  clearTimeout(entranceTimer);
  screens.forEach((screen) => screen.classList.remove('is-arriving', 'is-pending-entrance'));
  const screen = screens.find((candidate) => candidate.dataset.screen === state);
  if (!screen || screen.hidden) return;

  void screen.offsetWidth;
  screen.classList.add('is-arriving');
  entranceTimer = setTimeout(() => screen.classList.remove('is-arriving'), 1600);
}

function setState(state, { immediate = false } = {}) {
  requestedState = state;
  if (state === currentState && !immediate) return;
  if (state === 'attract' || state === 'processing') clearIdleWatchdog();
  const previousIndex = flowOrder.indexOf(currentState);
  const nextIndex = flowOrder.indexOf(state);
  const direction = nextIndex >= previousIndex ? 'forward' : 'backward';
  const reduceMotion = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
  const shouldShowSteps = state !== 'attract' && state !== 'result';

  if (!shouldShowSteps) app.classList.remove('has-flow-steps');

  document.documentElement.dataset.motion = direction;
  if (!immediate && !reduceMotion && document.startViewTransition) {
    const incomingScreen = screens.find((screen) => screen.dataset.screen === state);
    screens.forEach((screen) => screen.classList.remove('is-pending-entrance'));
    incomingScreen?.classList.add('is-pending-entrance');
    app.classList.add('is-view-transitioning');
    const transition = document.startViewTransition(() => applyState(state));
    const finishTransition = () => {
      app.classList.remove('is-view-transitioning');
      app.classList.toggle('has-flow-steps', shouldShowSteps);
      delete document.documentElement.dataset.motion;
      playScreenEntrance(state);
    };
    transition.finished.then(finishTransition, finishTransition);
    return;
  }
  applyState(state);
  requestAnimationFrame(() => {
    app.classList.toggle('has-flow-steps', shouldShowSteps);
    delete document.documentElement.dataset.motion;
    playScreenEntrance(state);
  });
}
